title: Slow, Heavy App with Incomplete QRIS Support
review_text:
I’ve been using the Jenius app for quite some time, but the experience has become increasingly frustrating.

First, the app feels very heavy and slow. This becomes especially noticeable when making QRIS payments in places with congested networks such as malls, convenience stores, or inside buildings. In situations where payments should be quick and seamless, the app often takes too long to load or respond. For something as simple as paying with QRIS, this level of sluggishness defeats the purpose of digital payments.

Second, the bank identity is confusing and inconsistent. In different banking apps, the same bank appears under different names — sometimes Jenius, sometimes BTPN, and sometimes SMBC. This inconsistency makes it unnecessarily difficult to find the correct bank when trying to transfer money.

Third, the QRIS implementation feels incomplete. The app only allows users to scan merchant QR codes, but it cannot display a personal QRIS code for merchants to scan. Some stores ask customers to present their QR code instead, and in those situations the Jenius app simply cannot be used.

Overall, the app feels unnecessarily heavy, inconsistent, and missing basic functionality that many other financial apps already support. I hope the team seriously prioritizes performance optimization, clearer bank identity across platforms, and a more complete QRIS implementation. Users rely on this app for everyday transactions, and the current experience falls short of what a modern digital banking app should deliver.

title: Formal Complaint Regarding Poor Customer Care, Unauthorized Charges, and System Security Issues
review_text:
I am writing to file a formal complaint regarding the extremely poor customer care I experienced and the serious issues related to unauthorized charges and system security.

Seven days ago, I used my credit card to make a one-time USD 1 payment on a website to download a file converter. The website does not require any signup or subscription—payments are only charged when downloading, and even previews are free. However, tonight I suddenly discovered a USD 40 charge from the same website, which is completely unauthorized.

When I contacted customer care, the representative was unprofessional, unclear, and excessively long-winded. Customer care should follow clear SOPs and respond promptly, yet he kept insisting that it was a “subscription payment,” even after I repeatedly clarified that the website is not subscription-based and operates purely through one-time payments. I had to firmly press him multiple times before he finally agreed to create tickets—one for blocking my card and another to dispute the transaction. The call lasted nearly 20 minutes, which is unacceptable considering the urgency of preventing additional unauthorized charges.

What makes this even more disappointing is the fact that Jenius has always been one of my favorite digital banks, and I have been a loyal user since its early days. It is extremely concerning that a “bank” cannot be fully trusted, and that customer care staff are unable to distinguish between issues that require urgent ticket creation versus those that are simply general inquiries. This lack of clarity and competence puts customers at risk and causes unnecessary stress.

Additionally, I am now constantly anxious about keeping funds in my Active Balance because unknown transactions can suddenly appear. It is exhausting to repeatedly block my card and wait for replacements.

Furthermore, the app often experiences errors and becomes slow, especially when transferring Flexi Cash to Active Balance. The system’s security, reliability, and the quality of customer care urgently need improvement to prevent incidents like this from happening again.

I request immediate action on the disputed transaction, improved customer service standards, and serious attention to Jenius’ system and security vulnerabilities.

Thank you.

title: Saldo terpotong dan tidak ada catatan history
review_text:
1. Mobile banking yg common diterapkan bank lainnya secara data historis itu menyediakan data debit, kredit, dan saldo. Jenius tidak ada historis saldonya. Hanya ada keterangan uang in & out berapa. Data statement yg didownload pun sama infonya, ga ada historis saldo

2. Saya melakukan transfer ke rekening jenius, saldo yg saya terima tidak sesuai dengan nominal yg saya transfer. Jumlah nominal yg saya terima lebih kecil, dan tidak ada keterangan potongan apapun di in&out. Sudah di follow up ke SMBCI care, dijawab dengan keterangan yg tidak konsisten, dan diminta utk cek berkala menunggu keterangan krn tagihan diterima 7 hari setelah tap transaction dilakukan. Transaksi saya trakhir tgl 14 dan ini sudah tanggal 25.

3. SMBCI care tidak helpful, saya belum selesai berbicara sudah diakhiri.

Silakan yaa untuk dipertimbangkan kembali dalam penggunaan digital banking ini.

title: Jebakan fitur cashcow pay&save
review_text:
Hati2 bertransaksi pembayaran dg Jenius. Saya bayar tagihan internet melalui jenius.  Setiap bulan membayar tagihan, saya harus mengisi nomor pelanggan internet secara manual , sampai kemudian muncul pilihan “pay & save” yang saya pikir itu pilihan men-save nomor pelanggan utk kebutuhan pembayaran bulan berikutnya. 
Ternyata “save” ini adalah “menabung dan disimpan dalam fitur cashcow” dan artinya saya didebet 2 kali utk pembayaran tagihan dan juga menabung.  Ketika saya menyadari, pihak jenius menyatakan bahwa penarikan dari cash cow  hanya bisa utk nominal minimum rp 5 juta. Sungguh patut diduga, ini jebakan karena pihak Jenius tidak memberikan informasi yang cukup dan terang ttg fitur ini,  termasuk ttg nominal minimum yg bisa ditarik. Mereka mudah saja memdebet walau nasabah kurang paham ttg fitur cash cow, namun  ketika nasabah ingin menarik dana dari cashcow: jenius menetapkan syarat yg tidak diinformasikan sejak awal

title: Great Concept, Still need Improvement.
review_text:
Initially I was impressed with the new account opening concept. They are the first bank that allow account opening from an app in INDONESIA.
I had trouble with the registration though, my first registration did not goes as smoothly as I hoped. But after quite some time, back and forth with the helpdesk and Jenius partners. Problem was solved.
Saving money never been so easy, interest rate are comparatively good, free transactions quota and withdrawals from ANY Bank's ATM in Indonesia is interesting. Separate top up e-card from visa would create a safer internet transaction..
Can't give full score on the apps due to the registration problem, but the bank's staff was very helpful.

PS : to the developer, when updating the apps it is customary to tell the App Store customer what is being updated (bug fix, encryption, new menu, etc) instead of commercials like "6,25% deposit etc. ".

title: Bring the whole new level for mobile banking experience!
review_text:
I’ve been using Jenius since i got my ID about 2 years ago and they never failed me :) Let me break down the point of why Jenius is really is JENIUS:

1. Jenius has the most interactive UI/UX i ever used up until this point and no bank could beat them. Like really? Jenius is definitely not just a Bank yet they really do care with their user.

2. I think the whole app of Jenius targeted for young generation. The color and the design seems too cheerful actually for a bank. But, indeed this is a successful approach for giving new kind of feeling when you are opening your mobile bank application. It give you the feeling of ease when you are doing any kind of transfer activity or just simply checking your monthly statement.

3. Have you ever wonder why mobile banking app didn’t provide any financial tracking system so that you could control your spending? Well, i did wonder. Mobile banking app is the most frequently used app related to finance in our daily life. The idea of Moneytory (sound like ‘monitoring’ to me lol) is such a dream comes true! 

4. I know too much add on in an app could actually brings the good or the bad side in different kind of situation. Thinking about the size of an app maybe not so many people thinking about it nowadays. But, for some minorities mobile banking app which consume a lot of memories might ends up being such a hassle. Consider a Jenius-lite maybe? It just an opinion though that comes across my mind while i am writing it. But afterall Good job there for the developers and everyone who pour their precious time for buildings this amazing banking app ⭐️

title: Feesible? Seriously?!
review_text:
Saya sudah lama pake jenius karna yang saya tau jenius adalah aplikasi sejenis ovo, gopay dll yang merupakan aplikasi e-money. Saya tau ini aplikasi yang dinaungi oleh bank btpn. 

Sudah lama tidak menggunakan aplikasi dikarenakan rumor dulu yang sempat dihack blablabla. Saya memberanikan lagi menggunakan jenius. Niat ingin menabung di flexisaver. Sudah berjalan seminggu, iseng cek saldo malah kepotong 110.000 (feesible). Saya tanya CS katanya kebijakan baru dari awal 2021 yang ada fee 10rb/bulan. 

Sebagai costumer saya kecewa. Ingat, jenius BUKAN bank, tapi aplikasi yang dinaungi oleh bank. Ovo, gopay, dana, dll tidak pernah saya tiba" ada potongan "feesible" bulanan.

Alhasil saya kecewa dan langsung proses penutupan akun. Via telfon. Salah satu cs yang dihubungi terlalu berbelit", nada bicara yang terlalu lambat sehingga pulsa saya keburu habis. Saya minta tolong sama cs di aplikasi jenius agar pihak jenius menelfon saya kembali, namun dari cs tidak bisa membantu.

"Aplikasi simpel" tapi untuk perihal menutup akun dipersulit.

Terima kasih, saya kecewa. Mungkin merupakan kesalahan saya tidak mengecek notif atau pemberitaan mengenai feesible. Tapi ya, tetap saya kecewa. Terima kasih.
